title: banchi: `make hooks` stays armed on a fresh clone, and its final check reads the config
why: Owner ask ask-mw6vybwdb8 part 1, 14:58 CST Nov 7. `make hooks` sets core.hooksPath, then its loop runs `git config --worktree --unset-all core.hooksPath` on each worktree. With extensions.worktreeConfig off (any fresh clone), --worktree writes the shared .git/config, so the loop clears the value it just set, yet prints "hooks armed". Reproduced 2026-11-03 and on banchi main affcbb7.
note: Fix the cause in the recipe: turn on extensions.worktreeConfig before the loop, or skip the unset for the main worktree. The final check reads `git config core.hooksPath` and fails when it is not the armed path. Red then green in githooks-selftest (fresh clone, worktreeConfig off). The report says when the cloud setup script's workaround can go. Repo banchi; main moves by PR only.
